{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yang Earth Rat''' (戊子, ''tsuchinoe nezumi''; onyomi ''boshi'') is the 25th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|af|Sestigdelige siklus|ar|دورة ستينية|arz|دوره ستينيه|as|ষাঠি বছৰীয়া আৱৰ্তন|ast|Ciclu sexaxenariu|bn|ষাটবার্ষিক চক্র|ca|Cicle sexagesimal|cdo|Găng-ciĕ|cs|Kan-č’|de|60-Jahre-Zyklus|eo|Ĉina sesdekjara ciklo|es|Ciclo sexagesimal chino|eu|Hirurogeitaka urteko ziklo|fa|چرخه شصت‌تایی|fr|Cycle sexagésimal chinois|hak|Kôn-chṳ̂|hy|Վաթսունամյա շրջան|id|Ganzhi|it|Ganzhi|ja|干支|ka|სამოცეული ციკლი|ko|간지|mk|Шеесетгодишен циклус|ms|Ganzhi|nn|Sekstiårig syklus|no|Sekstiårig syklus|ru|Система гань-чжи|sh|Seksagenarni ciklus|simple|Sexagenary cycle|su|Daur séksagenari|sv|Himmelska stammar och jordiska grenar|th|แผนภูมิสวรรค์|tr|Altmışlık döngü|uk|Шістдесятирічний цикл|vi|Can Chi|wuu|干支|xmf|გან-ჩჟიშ სისტემა|za|Gancei|zh|干支|zh_classical|干支|zh_min_nan|Kan-chi|zh_yue|干支|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 25th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Fire Pig|ja|丁亥}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Earth Ox|ja|己丑}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''戊'' is Yang Earth, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''子'' (Rat) is Yang Water; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Earth Rat (戊子)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): wùzǐ
** Cantonese (Jyutping): mou6 zi2
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: tsuchinoe-nezumi
*** On'yomi: boshi
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): muja (무자)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Mậu Tý

==Months of Yang Earth Rat==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose last digit is 0 or 5 (when the Heavenly Stems are {{ill|Kanoe (庚)|ja|庚|lt=Kanoe (庚)}} or {{ill|Kinoto (乙)|ja|乙|lt=Kinoto (乙)}}), the month of {{ill|November|en|November|qid=Q125|lt=November}} is considered the Yang Earth Rat {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=month (calendar)}}. However, the month referred to here may also be based on the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}} or on a seasonal month (from {{ill|Daxue (solar term)|en|Daxue (solar term)|qid=Q337815|lt=Taisetsu}} to the day before {{ill|Xiaohan|en|Xiaohan|qid=Q1190989|lt=Shōkan}}).

==Days of Yang Earth Rat==
The selection of auspicious days for Yang Earth Rat is as follows.
=== Selected Day ===
The Yang Earth Rat day is the 5th day of {{ill|Ten directions|ja|十方暮|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11405067}}.
